facts.diff: Reconstructed evidence: Add file exclusions to the shared linter configuration.

works-and-proven.name: works-and-proven
checked: Mapped the one changed behavior, the new `files.includes` in `biome.json` (lines 4-16), against every test that reads `biome.json`: `tests/lint-config.test.sh` and `tests/scaffold.test.sh:120-128`. The goal was to find the assertion that would fail if the `dist`/`build`/`coverage` skip or the JSON/`.vue`/`.svelte`/`.astro` skip stopped working. None of them asserts it. `tests/lint-config.test.sh` only runs the linter on files named explicitly (`bad.ts`, `good.ts`, `ugly.ts`). The scaffold test only compares the written bytes with the project's copy, and those bytes change together with the file. This probe would have caught a changed behavior with no automated pin; it found one (see finding).
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

findings.what: No automated test protects the new checker exclusions.

principal-engineer.name: principal-engineer
checked: Fetched `biome.json` at head sha 1234abc and compared its new `files.includes` (lines 4-16) with the hook's `exclude: '\\.(jsonc?|vue|svelte|astro)$'` in `.pre-commit-config.yaml:42`. This would have caught a context bug where the config and the hook disagree about which extensions are in scope. They agree: json, jsonc, vue, svelte and astro are excluded in both places. The list also starts with `"**"`, so the negations have something to subtract from, and all other files stay in scope.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

findings.what: The broad exclusions can hide source code in commonly named folders.

maintainable-no-slop.name: maintainable-no-slop
checked: Fetched the diff at 1234abc. The whole PR is one hunk: `biome.json:4-16` adds a `files.includes` block. I read it for comments, code paths or dependencies. That would have caught comment drift, an error-swallowing path or a new package name. There are none: the file is pure JSON config with no comments, no logic and no dependency.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

house-style.name: house-style
checked: Held the new `files.includes` block in `biome.json` (lines 4-16 at 1234abc) against the lint hook's `exclude: '\\.(jsonc?|vue|svelte|astro)$'` (`.pre-commit-config.yaml:42`). I also compared it with the scaffold template's copy of that exclude (`templates/pre-commit-config.yaml:18`). This would have caught a file-type exclusion list that differs from the project's one existing statement of what the linter must skip (for example, `.jsonc` or one of the three framework extensions missing, or an extra type). The five types match exactly.
notCovered: Other repositories and live service behavior.

voice.summary: The exclusions fix unwanted checks but have no regression test. Add coverage before merging.
